steps: You'll be bounced to a login page (dev/mock infra, not the product)
Submit — you land back in the app

coverageNotes: Sidebar nav (hover each item; active item marked; click to navigate). Theme toggle (flips light/dark? sticks?). Capture box (first line reads as title? type switcher note/todo/reminder/event changes the form? conditional fields make sense — reminder wants a time, event wants start/end? primary button blocks on missing required fields? new entry appears in the list below? Ctrl/Cmd+Enter? reveal and remove tags). Search (filters list live or debounced; clear; 'no matches' state for nonsense). Entries list (row click opens detail; todo checkbox toggles without navigating; keyboard arrows/Enter/Tab). Entry detail (read; Edit — change type, fields swap?; Delete — confirms first?; back link). Empty + loading states.
